## Prose stays a quote

> Note that this is a quote.

> Tips are welcome.

> Information is power.

> Warning signs were everywhere.

> Note

> **Warn**

> Note : a space before the colon.

> `Note:` in code.

## Colon markers

> Info: the build is nightly.

> Note: this is worth knowing.

> Warn: this deletes data.

> Warning: this deletes data too.

> Tip: use the cache.

> **Note:** emphasised with the colon inside.

> **Note**: emphasised with the colon outside.

> *Tip:* in italics.

> Notes:

> NOTE: shouting.

> wArNiNgS: mixed case.

> <!-- Info -->
> A marker kept off the page.

## GitHub alerts are unchanged

> [!NOTE]
> GitHub's note.

> [!WARNING]
> GitHub's warning.

## MkDocs admonitions are unchanged

!!! note
    MkDocs' note.
